title: Pocket Goes to Brisbane
refrain: "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
palette: jacaranda purple, river aqua, sunshine yellow, gum green, roof red
sky: bright clear yellow-blue morning → warm golden afternoon → orange and pink sunset → soft lilac dusk with twinkling lights
cover: Pocket sits on a riverside railing under a purple jacaranda tree, with a CityCat ferry and the Story Bridge across the river.

pages.text: Pocket peeks out of the backpack. The river sparkles in the morning sun. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a riverside railing seen from behind, under a purple jacaranda. Aqua river, CityCat and Story Bridge far off. Bright yellow-blue morning.

pages.text: Toot, toot! Pocket rides the CityCat ferry. The aqua water swishes and swooshes, and the wind tickles one bent ear.
pages.beat: Pocket on a ferry seat by the open window, facing the river. Sleek white-and-aqua ferry deck, bright morning light, plain sky above.

pages.text: Up above, the great Story Bridge stretches across the river. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket small on the ferry rail at left, looking up at the grey-green steel Story Bridge arching over aqua water. Clear blue morning.

pages.text: Splash, splash, splash! The lagoon at South Bank is shallow and cool, with sand like a real beach. Pocket watches the sparkles.
pages.beat: Pocket on a low railing at frame bottom beside a sandy lagoon beach with shallow aqua water, tiny far-off swimmers. Bright yellow sunshine.

pages.text: Purple jacaranda flowers drift down, soft as feathers. One lands on Pocket's ear. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a park bench under a jacaranda tree, a purple petal on its ear. Petals drifting, purple carpet on grass. Warm golden light.

pages.text: Tip-toe, tip-toe, tip-toe. Three white ibis birds strut past the bench on their long, thin legs.
pages.beat: Pocket on a bench at right. Three white ibis with curved dark beaks and thin legs walk across green grass. Golden afternoon light.

pages.text: At the sanctuary, a koala hugs a gum tree. He is very, very sleepy, and he does not move at all.
pages.beat: One grey koala asleep in the fork of a gum tree, Pocket on a fence rail nearby. Gum green leaves, warm golden light, plain lower area.

pages.text: Hop, hop, hop! Four kangaroos bounce across the grass. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Four tan kangaroos hopping across low grass, Pocket on a fence rail at left edge. Sky is orange-gold with gentle late sun.

pages.text: A tall Queenslander house stands on its stilts, with a red roof and a wide, cool porch. The sky turns orange and pink.
pages.beat: Pocket on a garden gate post, small, facing a white wooden house on tall stilts with red roof and porch. Orange and pink sunset sky.

pages.text: The sky turns lilac, and the city lights come on, one by one. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a hotel windowsill, seen from behind, looking at the river with tiny lights and a distant bridge. Soft lilac dusk.

pages.text: The lights twinkle on the river. Pocket yawns a big, slow yawn. One ear droops. Then the other.
pages.beat: Pocket small and sleepy on the windowsill, ears drooping. Twinkling lights reflected on pale lilac river, calm dusk sky.

pages.text: Pocket is tucked up in the hotel room, fast asleep. Goodnight, Pocket. Goodnight, Brisbane.
pages.beat: Pocket asleep on a cream pillow in a hotel bed. Window shows twinkling city lights on the river and soft lilac sky.

synopsis: Pocket wakes up in a warm, sunny Brisbane morning beside the river. Perched on a ferry seat, Pocket rides a CityCat past the Story Bridge, then splashes along with the eyes at the South Bank lagoon beach. Purple jacaranda trees drop soft petals, white ibis birds strut past a bench, and at the sanctuary Pocket meets a sleepy koala and a few hopping kangaroos. A Queenslander house stands tall on its stilts. When the warm evening comes, Pocket is tucked up asleep in the hotel room, with the city lights twinkling on the river outside.
setting: Brisbane: the river with CityCat ferries, the Story Bridge, the South Bank lagoon beach, purple jacaranda trees, a koala and kangaroos at a sanctuary, white ibis birds, Queenslander houses on stilts, a warm evening
framing: Composition: the picture fills the whole frame edge to edge like a photograph. The scene continues right up to every edge: no border, no margin, no frame line, no vignette, no paper edge, and no blank or plain strip on any side.
